categories.question: You find a quiet bend in the river with a few hours to spare. What do you settle in to do?

outcomes.name: Paint reflections
outcomes.description: Small watercolour easel with a river reflection forming on the page

outcomes.name: Stack a pebble rainbow
outcomes.description: Neat flat grouping of naturally coloured pebbles arranged in a rainbow on a picnic mat

outcomes.name: Watch dragonflies from the bank
outcomes.description: Two dragonflies hovering over a tuft of reeds near a pair of resting binoculars

outcomes.name: Try leaf-boat racing
outcomes.description: Two folded leaf boats with tiny twig masts drifting side by side
